evidence_quote:
Step 3: Haruto picked half of the remaining tomatoes.
Tomatoes picked by Haruto = 108 / 2 = 54
observed_error: The response halves the remaining tomatoes when determining how many Haruto picked.
violated_condition: Haruto picked all 108 tomatoes remaining after the birds ate, not half of them.
error_description: The response assigns Haruto only half of the 108 tomatoes remaining after the birds ate, although he picked the rest. The division 108 / 2 = 54 is arithmetically correct but applies an unsupported halving at picking, before the separate gift of half his tomatoes.
